messages:
Rhea: Heads-up — I built a tiny 'demo safeguard' checklist for HelixCare's renewal demo Fri. It's meant to be pasted into the invite as a one-pager so CS has a repeatable flow. Sharing here for edits.

Oliver: Love a one-pager. Can we make the warmup minimal but targeted (so KV cache + batching lanes get touched without burning tokens)?

Sam: Suggested 9-step micro-runbook (aim 10m):
1) Set success metric (30s) — confirm uptime & acceptable phrasing variance.
2) Tempo-warm (2m) — send 6 curated prompts: exact demo prompts only, low-response-length targets.
3) Cache nudge (1m) — run a short batch of 4 parallel calls to exercise batching lanes.
4) Quick probe (2m) — capture p50/p95/p99 + KV hit%.
5) Soft-fallback demo (2m) — show swapping to a lower-latency variant and describe expected wording shift.
6) Observability check (30s) — open Console "Per-route" and confirm token breakdown.
7) Repro pointer (30s) — paste repro for any tail spikes.
8) Capture notes (30s) — record any quality hits and owners.
9) Follow-up commitments (30s).

Tanvi: Repro one-liner for the probe (paste into support shell):
```bash
# 12 quick probes, report percentiles and kv hit
python /srv/tools/probe.py --tenant helixcare --model open-7b --n 12 --json | jq '.summary | {p50,p95,p99,kv_hit}'
```

Sam: Minimal cache-nudge (to paste into demo script):
```bash
for p in "short-ack" "summarize-1" "rewrite-legal"; do
  curl -s $API -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d "{\"model\":\"open-7b\",\"input\":\"$p\"}" >/dev/null &
done; wait
```

Rhea: Customer-facing blurb (short, put in invite notes): "During the demo, if we detect sustained degradation we will switch to a faster model variant to keep replies responsive. This preserves availability but may change phrasing subtly; we will log any differences and follow up with suggested prompt tweaks and a remediation plan."

Oliver: Ops checklist for the call: keep Console on Per-route, have canary toggle preloaded in staging, set tenant label helixcare-demo=true for 45m to capture scoped logs: `kubectl label pod -n prod tenant=helixcare-demo=true --overwrite`.

ops-bot: [deploy] HelixCare canary: last deploy 2026-03-01T11:05:00Z. No incidents.

Tanvi: Token estimate note: tempo-warm + cache-nudge ~200-700 tokens depending on response len. Worth calling out for AMs.

Rhea: Action owners: Tanvi — attach probe outputs and token est to invite; Sam — paste the two shells into the calendar notes; Oliver — rehearse canary toggle in staging and confirm Console view. I'll update invite and loop in the AMs.

Oliver: Rehearsal done, canary toggle ready in staging.

Sam: Probe script attached to invite. p50=40ms p95=180ms p99=510ms pre-warm; after the tempo-warm p99 falls to ~220ms.

Rhea: Great — adding to invite now and including a compact follow-up template for any quality regressions. See you Fri. :thumbsup:
